1.note: Printed so (the image reads מ"ו, not ט"ו); the two decrees are at Shabbat 14b–15b. Kept as printed.

2.note: Printed so; read as a misprint for מדעתם ('knowing', 'from their knowledge'), since מרעתם gives no sense.

3.note: אן as printed; read as a misprint for אם/פן, 'lest'.

4.note: Printed so, with no closing parenthesis; the sixty Ḥasidim killed by Alcimus are in 1 Maccabees 7:12–16.

5.note: Printed יוסף; the story is about Yose ben Yoezer.

6.note: Printed so, without a side of the leaf; the passage is at Yoma 16a.

7.note: Printed י': (10b); the statement that the early Ḥasidim longed to bring an offering stands in Nedarim 10a. Kept as printed.

8.note: The katafras rule is in Mishnah Oholot 3:7 as far as I know; kept as printed.

9.note: So printed; in the Tosefta and the Bavli the woman is Miriam daughter of Bilgah (of the priestly course Bilgah).

10.note: ח"ג read as 'vol. 3'; the work meant (Weiss's own or another) is not stated.

11.note: So printed; the verse quoted in the text is מחה אמחה (Exodus 17:14).

12.note: The chapter letter is unclear in the scan (ט or מ); read as ט.

13.note: מ"ט may be a misprint for מ"מ ("in any case"); the exposition of מאן ימאן is in Ketubbot 39b as far as I know. Kept as printed.
